purpose: Turn the frozen Q2-4 list into a finite, executable and independently repeatable contract: cases, draft inputs, row/missing-row semantics, checks, tolerances, counterexamples, and stopping conditions. No Geant4 run is performed or authorized by this document.
scope: Seven pre-registered cases: UNC-TOT, UNC-N1, UNC-ZERO, UNC-LET-COV, UNC-MT-SPARSE, UNC-COMPONENT, UNC-COVERAGE.
Pure mathematics and component-level checks for the statistics, plus a finite independent-batch coverage experiment.
Public CSV and metadata evidence only; every raw quantity has a named source column and file.
out_of_scope: No product, test, benchmark, freeze or table changes; no new observation fields, CLI or acceptance framework.
No universal confidence/coverage claim; no physical dose/LET validation.
No new cases, resampling, extra batches, or tolerance/seed changes after seeing results.
Finite-value protection is not re-verified beyond the existing product behaviour.

reproduced.method: independent exact-rational derivation: exact binomial normaliser 36^N, integer-interval equivalence, Decimal tails; see verify_coverage.py

inputs.note: Draft INI files use output paths under out/collab/q2-uncertainty-v1/runs/<case>/output; the execution task must copy them into its own candidate directory, verify every SHA, and may override the output directory with --output. The coverage batches must override only the seed with --seed.

formulas.dose_generation: dose_Gy_per_event_i = edep_MeV_i * 1.602176634e-13 / mass_kg; sum_Gy = sum_i dose_i; the dose CSV n_events is N (zero-deposition events contribute zero dose but count in N).
formulas.dose_moments: S = sum_i x_i over all completed events (x_i=0 for zero deposition); S2 = sum_i x_i^2; R = sqrt(S2/S^2 - 1/N); sigma = R*|S|; do not use the number of hits rows as N.
formulas.event_edep_merge: For every completed event there is exactly one event_edep row; the dose S output must equal sum(raw_edep_MeV_i)*1.602176634e-13/mass_kg within the pre-registered half-unit interval, and the event_edep raw sum must equal the dose CSV raw_edep_MeV.
formulas.ratio_delta: Q = B/A where the per-event moments are the moments of the weighted tallies: R_Q^2 = sumSq_B/B^2 + sumSq_A/A^2 - 2*sum_AB/(A*B), with sumSq_A=sum_i a_i^2 and sum_AB=sum_i a_i*b_i over completed events (zero contributions included). For unit-weight runs this coincides with the ordinary sample moments; the general formula is not an unweighted formula. For LET: let_t = B/A (A=sum_wl, B=sum_wSl, sum_AB=BA=sum_wl_x_wSl) so R_t^2 = sumSq_wSl/B^2 + sumSq_wl/A^2 - 2*BA/(A*B); let_d = C/B (denominator B=sum_wSl, numerator C=sum_wS2l, cross AC=sum_wSl_x_wS2l) so R_d^2 = sumSq_wS2l/C^2 + sumSq_wSl/B^2 - 2*AC/(B*C). Both delta ratios use their own cross moment; the unknown covariance between the two ratios is not set to zero.
formulas.half_unit_interval: Every project CSV scalar is printed with std::setprecision(12) in general format, which drops trailing zeros; the number of printed decimals therefore does not state the precision. For a non-zero finite printed value d the conservative half unit is h = 0.5 * 10^(floor(log10(|d|)) - 11), computed from the magnitude (Decimal.adjusted()), with the wider side used at a magnitude boundary; e.g. h(1)=5e-12, h(1000)=5e-9, h(1e-9)=5e-21. A printed exact zero is exact: no 0.5 tolerance is invented and zero is not given an interval. This half unit is propagated through every comparison of raw quantities, ratios and moments (sums, sumsq, masses, volumes, areas, rel_error, sigma and differences), never replaced by a uniform 1e-12 relative tolerance. Pure math verification (verify_moments.py, 20/20 pass) demonstrates the fixtures 1, 1000, 1e-9, -1000, 1.36016812632 and exact 0, shows the old string-exponent rule would be >=1e9 times looser, and shows the half-unit interval of let_d - let_t for the frozen REF-LET-01-EM 100 MeV values is about 4.2e-4 relative while the single values are 3.7e-12 relative.
formulas.fluence_bernoulli: For a fully covering 12x12 mm beam and a 10x10x0.1 mm Galactic slab, every crossing event contributes exactly 0.1 mm / 10 mm^3 = 0.01 mm^-2, so Phi = K/100 mm^-2 and sumSq/sum^2 - 1/N = 1/K - 1/N exactly for the uncorrected event-moment estimator. This is a model assumption that the execution must verify per batch: every event with a fluence entry has merged path length 0.1 mm.
formulas.coverage_single_batch: covered(K) := |K/100 - N/144| <= 2*(K/100)*sqrt(1/K - 1/N). With N=2000 and p=25/36 the exact integer equivalent used by verify_coverage.py is 36*|K - 12500/9| <= 2*sqrt(K*(1 - K/2000))*36; the frozen values are K in [1347,1429], probability 0.9559137115315595. The execution must apply the criterion to printed Phi and rel_error (half-unit intervals) and cross-check it with the exact integer form.

R_t^2 = sum_sq_wSl/B^2 + sum_sq_wl/A^2 - 2*BA/(A*B) equals the printed let_t rel_error^2 within the propagated interval; n_events=2000; status=approximate

cases.title: Sparse multi-thread merging
cases.purpose: N=2 on 4 workers guarantees at least two workers cannot have events, but the two events may land on the same worker; merge by global event id and by worker moments, never by averaging per-worker relative errors. The actual allocation is recorded; when fewer than two workers contain events the worker-average comparison is reported as not distinguishable instead of failing.

inputs.scoring: dose=true, let=true, event_edep=true, hits=false; point proton 10 MeV at (0,0,0) in the 10x10x2 mm Si slab

raw_quantities.name: global_events
raw_quantities.semantics: exactly 2 unique global event ids across all workers; no duplicated id is allowed to double count

raw_quantities.name: global_S
raw_quantities.semantics: equals the merged dose sum; N=2

raw_quantities.name: worker_dose
raw_quantities.semantics: sums and n_events add across workers

raw_quantities.name: worker_let
raw_quantities.semantics: A/B/C/BA/AC add across workers; ratios are computed only after merging

checks.rule: actual_threads=4; actual_completed_event_count=2; run_metadata.runs[0].completed_events=2
the union of event_edep eventIDs has size 2 and no duplicate; empty/missing worker files are allowed and are not an error

sum(raw_edep_MeV) equals dose CSV raw_dose_Gy*mass/1.602176634e-13, and sum(weighted_edep_MeV) equals dose CSV weighted_dose_Gy*mass/1.602176634e-13, both within the half-unit interval; weighted_edep_MeV is directly available, so no per-step weight column is required
dose scorer_statistics n_events=2, entries=number of events with deposition, rel_error equals sqrt(S2/S^2-1/2) from the merged moments

merge A,B,C,BA,AC and the three second moments sum_sq_wl, sum_sq_wSl, sum_sq_wS2l by summation (never by averaging per-worker errors); then compute let_t=B/A, let_d=C/B and both delta rel_errors from the merged moments and match the printed rows

the comparator records the merged rel_error and, for information, the arithmetic mean of per-worker relative errors when at least two workers contain events; it does NOT require the two numbers to differ under the actual sparse allocation, because N=2 can fall in one worker or the wrong average can be numerically degenerate; distinguishability is established only by a pre-specified component/copy fixture (two non-empty workers with different per-worker errors), keeping the frozen seed

scorer_statistics.csv.notes: n_events is the global run event count (zero contributions included); entries is the number of events with a non-zero contribution; rel_error uses sqrt(sum_sq/sum^2 - 1/N) with the global N; uncertainty_status follows the HistoryStatistics priority (events<2 insufficient_events, ratio denominator zero undefined_ratio, numerator zero zero_total, else approximate); estimator total for scalar quantities and ratio for LET ratios.

cases.notes: N<threads guarantees at least two empty workers; the proposal never assumes worker 0 has an event or that every worker writes a non-empty file. Sparse per-worker files are expected, not a failure.
limitations: Only two events; the case checks merge arithmetic, not statistical accuracy.
Path-type quantities are not recovered from ordinary hits when hits are disabled.

cases.title: Independent finite coverage batches
cases.purpose: 64 fixed-seed independent geantino batches test whether the reported uncorrected-event standard error covers the known total fluence; coverage is asserted only for this frozen model and sample.

inputs.physics: EM option4; default_cut 0.7 mm (frozen fluence reference settings)
inputs.scoring: fluence=true, hits=false, event_edep=false; 10x10x0.1 mm Galactic slab; 12x12 mm square geantino beam at z=-2 mm along +z

raw_quantities.name: K
raw_quantities.source: per batch: scorer_statistics.csv entries for raw_fluence/weighted_fluence, cross-checked with round(track_length/0.1) and with the event second moment; hits=false, so no per-event path is observable
raw_quantities.semantics: number of events with a fluence entry; the frozen straight-path model predicts every entry carries exactly 0.1 mm, sum_sq = K*0.1^2 and sum = K*0.1 mm; this is a finite analytic consistency check of the printed moments, not a reading of each event path

raw_quantities.name: Phi
raw_quantities.semantics: K/100 for the full-coverage model

raw_quantities.name: R
raw_quantities.semantics: sqrt(1/K-1/N) exactly for this Bernoulli model

raw_quantities.name: covered
raw_quantities.semantics: |Phi - N/144| <= 2*Phi*R with half-unit intervals, and the exact integer criterion as cross-check

checks.rule: exactly 64 runs with seeds 220001..220064, one each, all completed with N=2000; no extra batches, no resampling, no seed changes; unavailable samples are retained and reported, and any genuine failure stops the comparison instead of being replaced

per batch the entry count K, total track length and event second moment are mutually consistent with the frozen straight-path model (K=round(track_length/0.1), sum_sq=K*0.1^2); because hits=false the batch has no per-event path observation, so this is a finite analytic consistency check of the printed moments and must not be described as having read every event path; any inconsistency fails closed instead of tuning
report all K; the frozen single-batch covered range is [1347,1429]; do not widen it

reproduce the frozen design probability 0.9559137115315595 and the minimum covered count 57 (P(C<57)=0.006980515324) from the exact binomial; the design input is reproduced by verify_coverage.py (19/19 pass)
C = count(covered batches); C >= 57 must pass; C < 57 must fail without resampling
sum(K) must lie in the frozen central 99% range [88464,89313]; the expected total is 88888.888...; a miss is a fail, not a reason to extend sampling
the conclusion is limited to this frozen distribution/model/sample; no universal confidence claim

cases.missing_row_semantics: n/a (all batches must produce the same files)
cases.notes: The Bernoulli model requires the full 12x12 mm beam to cross the 10x10x0.1 mm slab with a full 0.1 mm path for every hit event. hits=false, so execution checks the model through the printed entry count, total path and event second moments per batch (not by reading each event path) and fails closed on inconsistency.
limitations: 64 batches are independent only in the fixed-seed sense; the design does not claim universal coverage.
Two tests each at 1% control; the union-bound false-rejection probability is <=2%, not a joint 1% claim.

forbidden_changes: product code, build files, tests, benchmarks, frozen decisions, NIEL tables, ROADMAP, STATUS
required_identity_checks: every input INI SHA from inputs_manifest.json
run_summary/metadata completion fields and every generated asset SHA
execution.failure_action: Keep the original inputs/outputs/logs and report the failure; never tune seeds, N, cut, tolerances, geometry or reference values to make a comparison pass.

counterexamples.mutation: use nonzero-contribution entries or ordinary hits row counts as N instead of the complete event count; a same-valued legitimate file is not claimed detectable, so the copy has a missing or duplicated event row
fabricate a zero_total row in scorer_statistics.csv
set BA and AC to zero in the recomputation
average per-worker rel_error instead of merging moments, applied to the pre-specified two-non-empty-worker fixture (the frozen sparse run is not forced to expose the difference)
replace a batch seed or add a batch
use mass in grams where kg is required in the dose identity

stopping.deliverable: out/collab/q2-uncertainty-v1/** plus docs/collab/outbox/20261105-q2-uncertainty-v1.md; candidate stops after independent review
stopping.no_extension: no extra batches, no re-runs to replace results, no tolerance changes after observing results
stopping.unavailable: a genuine unavailable sample (missing output, execution failure) is retained and reported; coverage comparison is not completed by replacement

boundaries: No universal coverage or confidence claim; results apply to this frozen model (12x12 mm beam, 10x10x0.1 mm Galactic slab, p=25/36, N=2000, seeds 220001..220064).
UNC-COMPONENT is component-level evidence only; it does not prove run-level products.
UNC-N1 and UNC-ZERO deliberately exercise extreme statistics; they say nothing about detector physics.
The dose/MC cross-check uses printed 12-digit values and magnitude-based half-unit intervals; absolute mc-truth accuracy is not claimed.

A complete event_edep file has exactly N data rows by contract, so its row count is not an independent N; rejection of entries/hits-row counts as N uses a mutated copy or the component fixture, never a claim that equal values differ.
The wrong per-worker error average is not required to differ under the frozen sparse allocation; distinguishability is shown only with the pre-specified two-worker component/copy fixture.

Coverage batches run with hits=false and therefore have no per-event path observation; the frozen straight-path model is supported only by the consistency of the entry count, total path and event second moments, not by reading every event path.

resolved_decisions: UNC-ZERO: enabled Dose/LET CSV writers produce registered header-only files; no scorer_statistics entry means no statistics file. Preserve these producer semantics.
A candidate-local minimal C++ probe may compile the actual HistoryStatistics implementation; no production API/build/test edits.
Keep em=option4 and the existing geantino inputs unchanged.
Retain genuine execution/evidence failures and stop; never replace seeds or extend samples.
clarifications: Fluence CSV path moments are L=0.1*K mm and L2=0.01*K mm^2; statistics fluence moments are S=L/V=0.01*K mm^-2 and S2=L2/V^2=0.0001*K mm^-4, with V=10 mm^3. Do not mix path and fluence units.
Single-batch noncoverage is an observation, not a run failure. Count coverage over exactly 64 seeds; only C<57 or aggregate K outside the frozen range fails the statistical criteria.

Independent reproduction, if used, repeats the same registered design and seeds in a separately identified dataset. It is not 128 independent random batches and must not be pooled or used to replace failures.

Repository relocation may rewrite only absolute resource/output paths; preserve all physical/statistical values and record both original and relocated input hashes. CLI seed overrides are only the frozen coverage seed table.
